comment: Registered A2A agent cards for Lab 7. The Gateway resolves agent identity from this server-side registry: an unknown workload is denied BEFORE any policy evaluation (ISO A.9.2). Registered does NOT mean trusted for permissions - a compromised agent with a valid card is exactly the confused-deputy scenario.

agents.name: SupplierBot
agents.note: Legitimately registered peer agent. Its card is valid - the compromise is behavioral (it forwards injected instructions), which is why identity alone is not authorization.
